one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-11-18 to 2026-12-17. The print is already out (2026-11-17 after the close): revenue $115.8B vs ~$109B expected, Q4 guide $130B +/-3%, FY28 growth target raised to ~75% (src 1, 9, 10); yet the stock fell 2.9% on 11-18 to $150.96 (Twelve Data quote; src 28 shows the same 11-18 price), after -36% in the month before the print (src 10) on the CEO's 11-12 resignation (src 9), the BIS remote-access/SE-Asia licence rule of 11-16 (src 15, 30) and the DOJ probe of a Singapore customer (src 10). In the window: the board's CEO search and investigation (any finding or a named permanent CEO is a two-sided jump), Federal Register publication of the BIS rule (starts the 90-day licence clock, src 30), possible Congressional testimony requests (src 30), Broadcom's and Oracle's December prints (AI demand read-through), and the December FOMC. Post-earnings drift after a large beat argues up, but the governance overhang and negative momentum argue against chasing it, so I center at $153 (between the 11-18 close and the 11-17 as-of close) with a monthly sigma of 13% (39%/3.5 = 11.1%, lifted for the event load).

Revenue FY27/28/29 $426B/$685B/$846B from customer AI capex (standing view base, reconciled to Q3 2026 actuals) x NVIDIA capture 34-37%. Peer P/Es re-marked on dated S&P Global consensus pages (median 23.5x).

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: horizon NTM levered FCF (NOPAT + D&A - capex 2.5% - 25% of revenue increase) / 5.1% exit yield

inputs_detail.derivation: TTM capex 7,354 / 302,970 = 2.4%; FY26 6,042/215,938 = 2.8%; fabless 3-6% per playbook, NVIDIA below the band.

Working-capital absorption = net income + D&A + SBC - CFO over the revenue increase: FY26 (120,067+2,843+6,386-102,718)/(215,938-130,497) = 31%; FY25 (72,880+1,864+4,737-64,089)/(130,497-60,922) = 22%; average 26.6%, rounded down to 25% because part of FY26-27 is the Rubin inventory build (inventory $31.6B -> $39.7B, src 1) that unwinds as supply normalises.

peer median forward FCF yield 2.44% = trailing FCF/mkt cap (secfacts src 28: AVGO 2.3%, AMD 0.8%, MRVL 1.4%) x next-year/this-year consensus EPS (src 27, 34, 35: 1.665, 2.189, 1.742) = 3.83%/1.75%/2.44%; x (own 6.11% / 2.44%)^0.8 = 508.5%; levered, no SBC deduction; weight 40% of P/E + FCF.
inputs_detail.variant_view: Trailing yields unadjusted (1.4% median) would value the leg far above the P/E leg; the growth adjustment is my estimate.

downside.story: 10th percentile: AI capex digestion starts in H2 CY2027 as hyperscaler free cash flow turns negative and neocloud funding tightens (CoreWeave and SpaceX build on debt; Microsoft cut CY2026 to ~$170B on delayed third-party capacity, src 22): customer AI capex 30% below base in every year (CY2027 ~1,226B and CY2028 ~1,509B, between the standing view's low path of 1,330B / 1,215B ex-shells), capture -2.5pt (Anthropic TPU multi-GW, Trainium, AMD Helios in volume, src 19), gross margin -3pt (HBM cost locked under SK hynix LTAs while ASPs give, src 18), and the governance/export overhang pushes the P/E below today's 11.2x as earnings fall (exit 13.0 - 3 = 10.0x), FCF yield 6.5%. The BIS SE-Asia licence rule (src 15) and the DOJ Megaspeed probe sit inside this case.

base.story: Median: customer AI capex follows the standing view's base (CY2027 $1.75T ex-China ex-shells, consistent with Goldman's $1.2T top-5), NVIDIA keeps ~37% capture as Vera Rubin becomes the largest NVL72 platform (TrendForce) net of TPU/Trainium/AMD gains, FY28 revenue ~$685B (~7.5% below the ~75% growth target, which is a supply statement), GM 72-73%, EPS FY28 ~$15.5 GAAP and FY29 ~$19.5; the governance discount narrows only partly (exit P/E 13.0x vs 11.2x today, against a dated 23.5x peer median).

upside.story: 90th percentile: 2027 capex follows the 2024-26 upward drift (Goldman $1.2T top-5, src 24, plus neocloud backlogs, src 20), NVIDIA's $203B FY28 supply commitments (src 1) let it ship ~$790B in FY28 (above the ~$742B guide), Rubin holds capture +1pt and GM 73-74%, a permanent CEO is named and the investigation closes, and the P/E re-rates to ~17x (exit +4), FCF yield 4.4%. Capex upside is capped at +12% because supply, not demand, binds in FY28 (src 12).

reasoning: Lane: industry/value chain. Start: Q3 FY27 (src 1) beat its own guide for the fourth straight quarter (+4.6% to +7.2% vs the first-guide midpoint, src 1/3/4/5/6), Q4 guide $130B, and interim CEO Kress raised the FY28 growth target to ~75% (src 9, 10). The stock is ~11x my NTM EPS because of the CEO resignation and investigation (src 9), the BIS rule (src 15, 30), the DOJ probe of a customer (src 10) and peak-cycle fear. Chain evidence: demand is still above supply at every supplier I checked: TSMC Oct revenue +59.7% y/y (src 16), AI accelerator CAGR mid-to-high 50s% reiterated (src 2) though 'prudent' for 2027 (src 17); SK hynix DRAM/HBM sold out to 2029 with LTAs over half of 2027-28 capacity (src 18); Hon Hai cloud beat its most optimistic forecast and sees supply tight into 2027 (src 21, 31); CoreWeave backlog $132.5B (+27% q/q, src 20, 33); B300 rental index +50% YTD (MS, src 26; weight: one supporting datapoint). Buyers: Big-4 Q3 capex $201.9B (+108% y/y), 2026 guides held (Microsoft trimmed to ~$170B), Alphabet 'increase significantly in 2027' (src 22, 23); Goldman $1.2T top-5 2027 (src 24). Competitors: AMD DC +97% with Helios at Anthropic, Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI and OCI (src 19, 32) is the share risk. Model: I keep the standing view's base customer capex (src 25; reconciled: Big-4 2026 ~730 vs 733, and its capture under-read NVIDIA by 3% once Q3 printed) and recalibrate capture to 34.05%, rising to 37% in FY28 on Rubin mix (TrendForce: VR200 the largest 2027 NVL72 platform, ASP ~2x GB300, src 29) and easing in FY29 on ASIC/AMD. That gives FY28 revenue $685B, 7.5% below the ~75% target: the target is a supply number ($203B of FY28 supply commitments carry ~$738B at 72.5% GM, src 1), and reaching it needs ~40% capture. GM inside the 72-73% target; opex +30%/+20%. FY29 EPS ~11% below the undated street figures I could see; FY27 revenue $426B vs the $424.0B consensus (src 13). Valuation: P/E exit 13.0x by the k = 0.8 shrink from 11.2x toward the 23.5x median of AVGO/AMD/MRVL NTM P/Es built from dated S&P Global consensus pages (src 27, 34, 35; the earlier undated peers.md snapshot was dropped); FCF yield 5.1% by the same rule on a growth-adjusted basis (low confidence); a mid-cycle P/E cross-check. Downside (P10 $125.40) moves capex -30%, capture -2.5pt, GM -3pt and the P/E to 10.0x; upside (P90 $393.74) is capped by supply. Not driver-linked: none (the custom leg is linked through driver_build.set). Sell-side targets (mean $247.76, src 13) are evidence only. Research was limited by blocked fetches (several relay sites, Chartmill) and no dated post-print FY28/FY29 consensus page; see gap_note.

custom.name: midcycle_pe
custom.explanation: Normalised-earnings cross-check (semis playbook, 0.2-0.4): FY2029 build revenue x mid-cycle operating margin 58% x (1 - 17% tax) / 23,720M horizon shares x through-cycle P/E 13.0x (the same peer-anchored exit P/E). 58% = below the FY24-FY27 average GAAP operating margin (54.1%, 62.4%, 60.4%, ~65.4%: 60.6%) to allow for a post-horizon digestion year; the FY20-FY23 cycle (16-37%) was a different, gaming-led business. Driver-linked through driver_build.set.

downside.story: 10th percentile: AI capex digestion starts in H2 CY2027 as hyperscaler free cash flow turns negative and neocloud funding tightens (CoreWeave and SpaceX build on debt; Microsoft cut CY2026 to ~$170B on delayed third-party capacity, src 22): customer AI capex 30% below base in every year (CY2027 ~1,226B and CY2028 ~1,509B, between the standing view's low path of 1,330B / 1,215B ex-shells), capture -2.5pt (Anthropic TPU multi-GW, Trainium, AMD Helios in volume, src 19), gross margin -3pt (HBM cost locked under SK hynix LTAs while ASPs give, src 18), and the governance/export overhang pushes the P/E below today's 11.2x as earnings fall (exit 13.0 - 3 = 10.0x), FCF yield 6.5%. The BIS SE-Asia licence rule (src 15) and the DOJ Megaspeed probe sit inside this case.

upside.story: 90th percentile: 2027 capex follows the 2024-26 upward drift (Goldman $1.2T top-5, src 24, plus neocloud backlogs, src 20), NVIDIA's $203B FY28 supply commitments (src 1) let it ship ~$790B in FY28 (above the ~$742B guide), Rubin holds capture +1pt and GM 73-74%, a permanent CEO is named and the investigation closes, and the P/E re-rates to ~17x (exit +4), FCF yield 4.4%. Capex upside is capped at +12% because supply, not demand, binds in FY28 (src 12).

model_inputs.structure_note: Quarterly driver set (16 quarters, 7 reported). Value is carried by the peer-anchored P/E (0.45) and FCF-yield (0.30) legs on the build's own FY28-FY29 NTM earnings at the horizon, plus a driver-linked normalised-earnings P/E custom leg (0.25, semis playbook cross-check). Drivers: ai_capex (customer AI DC capex ex-China ex-shells, $B; standing view base reconciled to Q3 2026 actuals) x capture (NVIDIA revenue per $ of capex) -> Data Center (~94% of revenue, driven share >90%); edge_rev plain; gm and opex give EBIT. No DCF leg (not a neocloud). Leg weights are judgment, untested.
model_inputs.gap_note: Process: the brief's 'approval before build' step (driver set to Kilian as a card) was not run by me; this is a forecaster set for the supervisor and the drivers need his approval before any live build. Consensus: no dated post-print FY2028/FY2029 consensus page was reachable on 2026-11-19 (StockAnalysis FY28+ is paywalled; MarketScreener and Nasdaq/Zacks show no publication date; Yahoo's page still showed pre-print figures; Chartmill refused the fetch). The only dated consensus used is StockAnalysis FY2027 ($424.04B revenue, EPS $9.65, 2026-11-18). The TIKR 2026-11-02 history is pre-print and is used only as a revision base rate, not as an input. Judgment calls for the supervisor: (1) capture path (FY28 37.0%): the file's own capture path (34.95%) gives FY28 DC ~$612B (~-6% research target); a supply-bound build at the $742B target needs ~40% (+~9%). (2) exit P/E k = 0.8 on a 3-peer median of dated S&P Global pages (23.5x); an AVGO-only basis (17.9x) gives 12.1x (about -3%). Peers.md (undated Alpha Vantage snapshot) is no longer used. (3) mid-cycle operating margin 58% in the custom leg. Not modeled for lack of a cited size: penalties from the DOJ/Treasury questions on SE-Asian diversion (src 10, 14) and the BIS licence rule's revenue effect (src 15); both sit in the downside case. Net debt: debt $33,366M (F98) less the $1.0B note repaid in Q3 (src 1) = $32,366M vs cash and marketable securities $53.5B (src 1) = -$21,134M; non-marketable equity stakes (OpenAI, Anthropic and others) are not valued (upside not counted). FCF-yield leg peer basis is my estimate (trailing yield x forward EPS growth), low confidence.
